title: Implications read their order and its dimension from the states
claim: On a base allowing exactly the up-sets of a finite poset, w lies between u and v in the disagreement count iff w is in their interval; a pair is comparable iff a joint pattern never occurs (under NAE with no tie all four occur); if every comparable pair lies in a 3-chain the betweenness triples give the comparability graph, and on connected posets the order up to reversal, so the order dimension is read from the states (1 chain, 2 product of two chains, 3 of three); on the NAE chain grid every grid assignment extends (no betweenness among grid distinctions), and the chain grid is Ising with tanh K = -1/3 above Tc, axis gap ln(3/2) (Onsager).
standard_statement: Betweenness of the symmetric-difference metric on principal filters of the distributive lattice of up-sets equals order intervals; comparability from forbidden 2-patterns; betweenness determines a connected poset up to duality when every comparability lies in a 3-chain; comparability invariance of order dimension; Ising high-temperature correlation length.
prior_work: Dushnik and Miller 1941; Komm 1948; Gallai 1967; Trotter, Moore and Sumner 1976; Golumbic 1977; Birkhoff; Glivenko 1936; Pitcher and Smiley 1942; Onsager 1944; DISTANCE-ORDER-20261117-001A (betweenness is a three-place constraint).
completion_gate: check.py passes (400 random orders; chain grids; Onsager formula), the referee thread reviews the proofs, and each statement keeps its provenance label.
